scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n frontend,backend -c cyan,magenta "npm --prefix match-me-actual run dev" "npm --prefix match-me-backend run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix match-me-actual run build && npm --prefix match-me-backend run build
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n frontend,backend -c cyan,magenta "npm --prefix match-me-actual run start" "npm --prefix match-me-backend run start"
scripts.install:all: npm --prefix match-me-actual install && npm --prefix match-me-backend install
